newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung quits as CEO of Orient Overseas.
newsitem.headline: Tung quits as CEO of Orient Overseas.

text.p: Hong Kong tycoon Tung Chee-hwa said on Friday he had resigned from the position of chairman and chief executive officer of family-controlled shipping group Orient Overseas (International) Ltd effective from the end of the business day.
His brother, C.C. Tung, has been appointed acting chairman pending the appointment of a new chairman by the board of directors, the company said in a statement.

Tung, regarded as a front runner for the post of Hong Kong's future Chief Executive, who will take over from British governor Chris Patten when the colony reverts to China next year, had been expected to step down from his business post.
